english.title: How much power did the second dose arm cost? Reading the FURVENT topline results
english.summary: A Japanese technical note that back-calculates the events behind the FURVENT firmonertinib phase 3 comparison from reported values, compares power with a hypothetical two-arm trial, and reads the result alongside WU-KONG28, PAPILLON, EXCLAIM-2 and the central-versus-investigator discrepancy. It does not conclude that dose optimization caused the failure.
